meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多来源深度调研自动整理成带引用的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需针对复杂问题多方位查证并输出有证据的总结
copy.tagline_en: Automatically turn multi-source research into cited reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need multi-source research and evidence-backed summaries

howto.what: 当你明确要求研究时，它会进入研究模式：先提议交付格式（默认 PDF/DOCX），再并行搜索代码库、网页、官方文档和开源库，追线索到穷尽，跑代码验证争议，产出带引用、图表和附件的报告，并做视觉质检和实时日志。
howto.when: 当你说“ulw-research”等“ulw”研究词、要求“ultradebate/hyperdebate”研究，或用任何语言明确提出“深度研究/精确调查”时触发；普通问题不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 对这个项目做一次彻底的调研。
say.note: 会进入 ULW-RESEARCH 模式并展开搜索。

say.text: 做一次深度研究，把这几篇文章里的争议点都查实。
say.note: 会并行查多个来源，并用跑代码来验证关键说法。

say.text: 来一次 hyperdebate 调研，把正反两方证据都整理出来。
say.note: 会安排至少两个辩论视角审视证据后再出报告。

howto.what_en: On explicit research request, ULW-RESEARCH: propose PDF/DOCX format, parallel search code/web/docs/OSS repos, chase leads to exhaustion, verify by running code, deliver cited synthesis with charts/assets after visual QA, live journal.
howto.when_en: Triggered only by explicit research demands: 'ulw-research', 'ultradebate'/'hyperdebate', or any-language research/deep-research/ultra-precise investigation. Never for ordinary questions or debugging.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to do a thorough investigation of this project.
say_en.note: Enters ULW-RESEARCH mode and fans out searches.

say_en.text: Do a deep research run and verify every disputed claim in these articles.
say_en.note: Parallel source checks; claims verified by running code.

say_en.text: Run a hyperdebate-style investigation and lay out evidence for both sides.
say_en.note: Skeptic views attack claims before the report is written.
